tools.name: binary_triage
tools.description: Inspect a binary for magic header signature, Shannon entropy (packing/encryption detection), UPX markers, and ASCII/UTF-16LE strings.

tools.name: executable_inspect
tools.description: Parse Linux ELF32/64, Windows PE32/PE32+, and macOS Mach-O / Universal binary headers, sections, entry points, and exploit mitigations (PIE, ASLR, NX, RELRO, CFG).

tools.name: disassemble_wasm_or_hex
tools.description: Disassemble WebAssembly (.wasm) bytecode into .wat text or decode x86-64, AArch64, and RISC-V machine code hex bytes.

tools.name: wasm_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a WebAssembly (.wasm) binary module for sections, function signatures, imports, exports, and linear memory page allocations.

tools.name: archive_join_and_verify
tools.description: Stitch split multi-part archive chunks, detect magic file header, compute & verify SHA-256 checksum, and peek ZIP Central Directory entries.

tools.name: hexdump_inspect
tools.description: Generate an annotated hex + ASCII dump of a binary range with Shannon entropy classification and multi-endian int/float data inspection at offset.

tools.name: archive_peek_central_dir
tools.description: Inspect ZIP Central Directory headers (filenames, compression method, CRC-32, sizes) or POSIX USTAR TAR entry headers without full extraction.

tools.name: pcap_inspect
tools.description: Parse libpcap (.pcap) packet capture headers and decode Ethernet, IPv4, TCP, UDP, and DNS/HTTP packet summaries.

tools.name: exif_inspect_and_strip
tools.description: Inspect JPEG APP1 EXIF/XMP/ICC segments for GPS coordinates, camera Make/Model, and timestamps, and optionally strip metadata cleanly.

tools.name: sqlite_header_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a SQLite3 database binary header (page size, schema cookie, encoding, WAL/journal version) and scan root B-tree SQL CREATE statements.

tools.name: sourcemap_analyze
tools.description: Audit a JavaScript SourceMap (.js.map) v3 JSON file to break down bundled byte attribution per source module and spot bloated dependencies.

tools.name: unicode_inspect
tools.description: Inspect every Unicode code point in text for zero-width joiners, bidirectional Trojan Source overrides, homoglyph spoofing, and UTF-8/UTF-16 byte encodings.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "sqlite_header_inspect" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Inspect a SQLite3 database binary header (page size, schema cookie, encoding, WAL/journal version) and scan root B-tree SQL CREATE statements.
